name: bad-entries-located
breaks: a location is made only of an entry with a string name and a string hash
red: stores and relays the entries with a name and hash, and refuses the one without

name: refused-unnamed
breaks: a node names the entries of a message it refused
red: stores and relays the entries with a name and hash, and refuses the one without
stores and relays nothing of a message whose every entry is refused, and keeps the sender's rows

name: every-refused-stored
breaks: a message whose every entry is refused is stored nowhere and relayed nowhere
red: stores and relays nothing of a message whose every entry is refused, and keeps the sender's rows

name: cleared-never
breaks: a node says it cleared the sender's rows
red: deletes the sender's rows on a message that names no apps

name: relayed-never
breaks: a node relays an announcement that is news to it
red: stores and relays the entries with a name and hash, and refuses the one without
stores and relays nothing of a message whose every entry is refused, and keeps the sender's rows
deletes the sender's rows on a message that names no apps
